title: 第176章 肯定是这微波炉不行！
slug: 让我开早餐店我下午才营业
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

大飞冷笑一声，抽出纸巾擦了擦手。

“林老板，咱们讲点道理。第一，你们花一万块钱买的是探店视频。我拍了，而且按照你们的要求，大加特加了滤镜，通篇都在夸你们的装修和你们的长相。这钱我赚得明明白白，对吧？”

“可是你……”

“你先听我说完。”

大飞直接打断她，“第二，我离开你们店之后，去哪吃饭，去拍哪家店，这属于我个人的自由。合同里可没写我不能拍同一小区的其他店。”

林雪被怼得哑口无言。她憋了半天，怒吼道，“这是我们的事！你这是违背职业道德！”

“职业道德？”

大飞的声音彻底冷了下来，“林老板，你还有脸跟我提职业道德？”

大飞把手机拿近了一点，语气里透着毫不掩饰的讥讽。

“我劝你们一句，做人留一线。我能顶着那带冰碴子的馅，硬生生把你们的破盘子吹出花来，我已经是对得起那一万块钱了！怎么着？还想让我给你们洗白这是纯手工现包的？”

嘟，嘟，嘟。

电话直接被挂断。

林雪握着手机，听着听筒里传来的忙音，脸色铁青。

“他挂我电话！”

张莉赶紧拿开旁边的冰奶茶，“怎么说？大飞退钱不？”

“退个屁！”

林雪咬牙切齿道，“他居然说我们给他的包子带冰碴子！说他帮我们吹已经很讲职业道德了！”

“带冰碴子？”

赵可儿皱起眉头道，“不可能啊。咱们进的这批货，就算再怎么差，也不至于加热完还是冰的。说明书上不是写着两分钟吗？”

“去后厨看看！”林雪踩着高跟鞋，大步走向推拉门。

厨房里。

黄毛正蹲在地上刷短视频，紧身衣男靠着水槽剔牙。

“哐当！”推拉门被粗暴地推开。

黄毛手一抖，差点把手机掉地上。他迅速站起身，换上一副憨厚的笑脸，“老板，怎么了？”

林雪目光在两人脸上扫过，指着案板上的速冻虾饺包装袋，“你们两个，加热的时间到底是多久？”

黄毛愣了一下，立刻挺直腰板，拍着胸脯说道，“老板放心，我们肯定按照说明书上的时间去打的。一秒都没少！”

紧身衣男在旁边连连点头，“对对对，就在旁边盯着看呢。”

林雪狐疑地看着微波炉，“那怎么有客人吃出冰碴子？”

“冰碴子？”

黄毛瞪大眼睛，满脸无辜道，“那绝对不可能。老板，我们可是把活当成自己的事业来干的。是不是客人口味太刁了？”

赵可儿双手抱胸，“可能那个大飞故意找茬。算了，出去吧，前面还一堆事。”

Page (1/3)

Da Fei sneered, took out a tissue and wiped his hands.

"Boss Lin, let's talk some sense. First, what you spent 10,000 yuan on was a store tour video. I filmed it and added filters according to your request. I praised your decoration and your appearance throughout the whole video. I clearly earned this money, right?"

"But you..."

"Listen to me first."

Da Fei interrupted her directly, "Secondly, after I leave your store, where to eat and which store to photograph are my personal freedom. There is nothing in the contract that states that I cannot photograph other stores in the same community."

Lin Xue was stunned speechless.She held it in for a long time and roared, "This is our business! You are violating professional ethics!"

"Professional ethics?"

Da Fei's voice turned completely cold, "Boss Lin, do you still have the nerve to talk to me about professional ethics?"

Da Fei brought the phone closer, with undisguised sarcasm in his tone.

"I would like to advise you, keep a thin line in your life. If I can hold up the icy stuffing and forcefully blow out your broken plates, I am already worthy of the ten thousand yuan! What's the matter? You still want me to prove to you that this is handmade and freshly wrapped?"

Toot, toot, toot.

The call was immediately hung up.

Lin Xue held the phone and listened to the busy signal from the receiver, her face livid.

"He hung up on me!"

Zhang Li quickly took away the ice milk tea next to her, "What should I say? Will Dafei refund the money?"

"Back off!"

Lin Xue gritted her teeth and said, "He actually said that we put ice cubes on his buns! Saying that he helped us blow it is already very professional!"

"Bring ice ballast?"

Zhao Keer frowned and said, "It's impossible. No matter how bad the batch of goods we buy is, it won't still be iced after heating. Doesn't the instruction manual say two minutes?"

"Go to the kitchen and have a look!" Lin Xue stepped on her high heels and strode towards the sliding door.

in the kitchen.

Huang Mao was squatting on the ground and browsing short videos, while the man in tights was leaning against the sink and picking his teeth.

"Bang!" The sliding door was violently pushed open.

Huang Mao's hand shook and he almost dropped his phone on the ground.He quickly stood up and put on a simple and honest smile, "Boss, what's wrong?"

Lin Xue glanced at the two people's faces and pointed at the quick-frozen shrimp dumpling packaging bag on the chopping board, "You two, how long do you need to heat it?"

Huang Mao was stunned for a moment, then straightened his back immediately, patted his chest and said, "Don't worry, boss, we will definitely play according to the time in the instructions. Not a second will be missed!"

The man in tights nodded repeatedly, "Yes, yes, I'm just watching from the side."

Lin Xue looked at the microwave suspiciously, "Then why did a guest eat ice cubes?"

"Ice ballast?"

Huang Mao's eyes widened and he said innocently, "That's absolutely impossible. Boss, we treat our work as our own business. Is the taste of our customers too picky?"

Zhao Keer crossed his arms and said, "Maybe that Da Fei is deliberately looking for trouble. Forget it, go out, there are still a lot of things ahead."
